name: de2-115
device_part_note: EP4CE115F29C7 is the commonly cited part number for Terasic's DE2-115, but has not been independently verified against the board's official datasheet in this session -- confirm before use.
notes: fsm_encoding_pragma is intentionally null: Quartus has no single universally-reliable inline SystemVerilog attribute equivalent to Vivado's fsm_encoding -- it is normally set via the Quartus Assignment Editor / a .qsf assignment instead, not inline SV. emit_parser.py omits the pragma line and writes an explanatory comment when this is null. ram_style_pragma ('ramstyle = "M9K"') is Quartus's standard inline RAM-style attribute -- reasonable-confidence but NOT synthesis-verified on this machine (no Quartus installed here).
